summary: Detect tool failures that Rightbrain records as successful.
reason: tool_outcome reflects whether the tool CALL completed, not whether the tool succeeded. A Notion 404 arrives as outcome success carrying a [Tool Error] payload, so a run where every call failed reported tool_error_count 0. The events endpoint omits outcome entirely, making payload inspection the only signal there.
validated_outcome: Against a live run whose Notion fetch 404d: tool_error_count 0 -> 1, with silent_tool_failures 1 and the reason attached.
